announcements.title: Young Adult (YA) Conference - October 2026

announcements.title: Parthi Yatra 2027 Pilgrimage Announcement
announcements.content: Planning for the Zonal Parthi Yatra 2027 pilgrimage to Prashanthi Nilayam, Puttaparthi has begun. All center families, YAs, and SSSE students are invited to register interest.

announcements.title: Thursday Midweek Devotional Bhajans (8:00 PM - 8:30 PM)
announcements.content: Join us every Thursday evening from 8:00 PM - 8:30 PM for 30 minutes of uplifting midweek bhajans and Namasmarana.

announcements.title: Monthly FMSC (Feed My Starving Children) Volunteer Drive

missed_session_recaps.title: Weekly Meeting Recap - Aug 30, 2026
missed_session_recaps.balvikas_summary: SSSE Group 1 & 2 reviewed Lesson 21 on Omnipresent God with interactive slides. Group 3 & 4 discussed 'Practicing Truth in Daily Student Life'.
missed_session_recaps.study_circle_summary: Discussed Geetha Vahini Ch 4: 'Action without Attachment (Nishkama Karma)'. Focus on balancing work, family, and spiritual sadhana.
missed_session_recaps.bhajan_summary: Sung 8 Bhajans focused on Divine Mother & Shiva. Outstanding vocal and instrumental support (Harmonium & Tabla) by Mesa YA Wing youth.

missed_session_recaps.title: Weekly Meeting Recap - Aug 23, 2026
missed_session_recaps.balvikas_summary: SSSE Lesson 22 - Love in Action. Students prepared gratitude cards for Mesa first responders.
missed_session_recaps.study_circle_summary: Theme: 'Cease to do Evil, Learn to do Good'. Practical tips on speech control and positive thinking.
missed_session_recaps.bhajan_summary: Sung 7 Bhajans including Ganesha, Krishna, and Sarva Dharma songs.

balvikas_classes.current_lesson: Swami's 5 Human Values through Prayers & Stories
balvikas_classes.summary: Learning simple Sai prayers, devotional coloring, and stories on Sathya, Dharma, Shanthi, Prema, and Ahimsa.
balvikas_classes.homework: Practice saying 'Om Sri Sai Ram' every morning and draw a flower for Swami.

balvikas_classes.summary: God is everywhere like air and light. We can feel God's presence by being kind and helpful to everyone.
balvikas_classes.homework: Practice 3 acts of kindness this week and draw a picture of your favorite nature scene.

balvikas_classes.current_lesson: Lesson 22: Service to Man is Service to God
balvikas_classes.summary: Understanding Seva principles and preparing for the FMSC volunteer packing event.
balvikas_classes.homework: Write 5 lines on why helping the hungry is divine service.

balvikas_classes.summary: Analyzing food, time, energy, and money waste in daily teenage life.
balvikas_classes.homework: Maintain a 7-day Ceiling on Desires journal tracking daily screen time and food waste.

balvikas_classes.current_lesson: Integrating Sai Teachings with Academic & Career Goals
balvikas_classes.summary: Applying 3Ps: Purity, Patience, Perseverance in high school, SATs, and college prep.
balvikas_classes.homework: Read 2 pages of Sathya Sai Speaks Vol 1 and prepare 1 discussion prompt for next week.

study_circle.next_topic: Geetha Vahini - Chapter 5: Control of Mind & Sense Organs
discussion_prompts: How do we calm our thoughts during stressful work/school days?
What is Swami's practical formula for sense regulation?
How can family members support each other in spiritual discipline?

past_topics.key_takeaway: Offer all actions as a prayer without anxiety over the results. Duty is God, Work is Worship.
Truth in speech creates inner peace. Standing up for righteousness in small daily choices.

all_sevas.title: YA Environmental & Community Service Drive

all_sevas.title: Back-to-School Backpack & Winter Coat Drive
all_sevas.description: Collecting backpacks, stationery, and warm jackets for Mesa public school students in need.

special_events.title: Young-Adult (YA) Regional Conference 2026
special_events.description: Uplifting weekend conference for Young Adults (ages 18-35) featuring spiritual workshops, musical rehearsals, leadership panels, and team seva.

ya_wing.title: Young Adult (YA) Wing (Ages 18-35)

ya_wing.description: The Mesa Young Adult Wing actively engages young adults in spiritual, devotional, service, and educational activities. YAs lead musical accompaniments, coordinate community sevas, and run technical audio/visual setup for center meetings.

activities.description: YA vocalists and instrumentalists lead Harmonium, Tabla, Dholak, Percussion, and vocal harmonies every Sunday and at special festival celebrations.

activities.title: 🤝 Community Seva Projects
activities.description: Coordinating FMSC packing shifts, leading homeless hot breakfast prep, environmental park cleanups, and local food drives.

activities.title: 💡 YA Study Circles & Retreats
activities.description: Bi-weekly youth-led study circles focusing on applying Swami's teachings to university, career, relationships, and modern mental well-being.

upcoming_conference.title: Zonal YA Conference — October 16-18, 2026
upcoming_conference.details: Three days of inspiration, devotional music workshops, panel discussions with senior devotees, and hands-on service.

seva_breakfast.title: Bi-Weekly Homeless Hot Breakfast Seva
seva_breakfast.location: Pioneer Park / Mesa Homeless Shelter Area, Mesa, AZ
seva_breakfast.instructions: Please arrive by 6:30 AM if helping setup/cook, or 7:00 AM for distribution. All hot cooked items should be delivered in disposable foil trays.

seva_fmsc.title: Feed My Starving Children (FMSC) Monthly Seva
seva_fmsc.location: FMSC Mesa Site, 1345 S Alma School Rd, Mesa, AZ 85210
guidelines: Minimum age is 5 years old. Kids 5-17 must be accompanied by an adult.
Adult-to-child ratio requirements: 5-9 yrs (1 adult per 3 kids), 10-17 yrs (1 adult per 4 kids).
No jewelry allowed in packing room (wedding bands permitted). Closed-toe shoes required.
Arrive 15 minutes prior (1:45 PM) for orientation and hairnet distribution.

registrations.notes: Will join directly at site by 1:45 PM
